text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Giving thanks to the winds of bounty.
—Itadakimasu.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Survival of the fittest is the law of nature. ...It cannot be helped.
...My own carelessness brought this upon me...

A black kite swooped in and snatched her sandwich,
leaving Yamanin Zephyr without any lunch...
